Description: Decoding accuracy and head velocity (learning, retrieval, memory), with and without HD control. Learning data averaged over bootstraps

Dimensions.learning_accuracy: subject x class x test time x train time (mean over bootstraps)
Dimensions.learning_velocity: subject x class x time (mean over bootstraps)
Dimensions.retrieval_accuracy: subject x class x test time x train time
Dimensions.memory_accuracy: subject x test time x train time
Dimensions.learning_train_labels: without HD control, per participant: class / head-direction label per training trial, as in the RSA data
